mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining FEDFUNDS or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >40% of triggered instances or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic weakness in consumer demand and manufacturing, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both decline in the last month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >60% of interaction instances or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion phases marked by high housing starts (HOUST), S&P 500 forward returns turn negative due to stretched valuations and heightened policy tightening risks over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >40% of late-cycle expansion periods or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during rising PAYEMS periods or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >60% of triggered instances or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases and unemployment rate declines signal aggressive monetary tightening during labor market strength, raising borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls in the last month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >60% of interaction instances or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) during manufacturing contraction phases signals reduced supply chain activity and corporate profit headwinds, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >60% of manufacturing contraction periods or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
